title: Victorian Government Building Reform
issuingAuthority: Victorian Government (Department of Transport and Planning)
summary: Primary Victorian Government reform page used for registration expansion, role-information measures, building-manual requirements for specified classes, and rectification-order settings.
limitations: This source is used only for the stated Victorian reform measures. Class 1b/2/3 building-manual requirements are not to be represented as a general Class 1a renovation requirement. It does not determine whether any future RRC model should be adopted.
notes: Page last-updated date recorded where available from source page metadata. Use only official Victorian Government wording and scope limits.

title: Victorian Cladding Risk Mitigation Framework
issuingAuthority: Victorian Government (Department of Transport and Planning)
sectionsReliedUpon: 3. Procedure for mitigating cladding risk on relevant buildings
summary: Primary Victorian Government framework setting risk-based combustible-cladding interventions for relevant buildings, including acceptable-risk outcomes and proportionate remediation pathways.
limitations: This framework is specific to relevant buildings and combustible-cladding fire-risk mitigation. Its legal or technical provisions are not to be applied to ordinary Class 1 renovation carpentry.
notes: Scope is cladding-specific. Linked framework materials include Minister's Guideline MG-15 (22 September 2023), used as publication-date reference.
